Rep. Barr nails it: Housing First failed because D.C. bureaucrats love throwing cash at problems they don’t understand. The Housing Is a Human Right Act (H.R.1708) is a $300B taxpayer-funded slush fund—$100M annually for “alternatives to criminalizing homelessness” and $10M for library pilot grants. 

Meanwhile, Section 601 imposes luxury real estate taxes to fund this bureaucratic black hole. They’re more focused on penalizing property owners than solving homelessness. 

Time to cut the waste and demand real accountability—not more handouts to failed programs.
